policy.selection_rule: Prefer project-native pinned flows, then maintained open/vendor tools. Record licenses, versions, targets, and rejected alternatives.
policy.comparison_rule: Compare PPA only in the same technology/device flow and compare workloads only under matched numerical and system constraints.

entries.name: Verilator
entries.use_when: Compile, lint, and cycle-simulate synthesizable SystemVerilog with C++ or cocotb testbenches.

entries.name: Icarus Verilog
entries.use_when: Run lightweight Verilog/SystemVerilog compile and simulation checks.

entries.name: cocotb
entries.use_when: Build Python-driven randomized and reference-model RTL verification.

entries.name: Verible
entries.use_when: Lint and format SystemVerilog with machine-readable diagnostics.

entries.name: slang SystemVerilog compiler
entries.use_when: Perform standards-oriented SystemVerilog parsing, elaboration, and diagnostics.

entries.name: Yosys Open SYnthesis Suite
entries.use_when: Synthesize open RTL, inspect cells/memories, and support SMT-based formal flows.

entries.name: SymbiYosys
entries.use_when: Run bounded/unbounded safety, liveness, cover, and equivalence properties.

entries.name: nextpnr
entries.use_when: Place and route supported open FPGA families after Yosys synthesis.

entries.name: AMD Vivado
entries.use_when: Build, implement, time, power-estimate, and program AMD/Xilinx FPGA prototypes.

entries.name: Intel Quartus Prime
entries.use_when: Build and sign off Intel FPGA prototypes.

entries.name: LiteX
entries.use_when: Integrate a CPU, buses, LiteDRAM, peripherals, and custom accelerator into an FPGA SoC.

entries.name: OpenROAD
entries.use_when: Perform floorplan, placement, CTS, routing, extraction, and STA in an open RTL-to-GDS flow.

entries.name: OpenROAD Flow Scripts
entries.use_when: Run reproducible, comparable RTL-to-GDS PPA experiments across supported public platforms such as SKY130, Nangate45, and ASAP7.

entries.name: LibreLane
entries.use_when: Run a reproducible open-source ASIC flow around Yosys, OpenROAD, Magic, KLayout, and Netgen.

entries.name: OpenSTA
entries.use_when: Run static timing analysis with explicit libraries, parasitics, corners, and SDC constraints.

entries.name: KLayout
entries.use_when: Inspect GDS/OASIS and run scripted DRC/LVS/layout checks.

entries.name: Magic VLSI
entries.use_when: Run open-PDK layout, extraction, and DRC steps.

entries.name: Netgen LVS
entries.use_when: Compare extracted and schematic/netlist connectivity for LVS.

entries.name: SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK
entries.use_when: Target an open 130nm digital proof-of-concept or shuttle-compatible design.

entries.name: Nangate Open Cell Library 45nm platform
entries.use_when: Produce a reproducible 45nm academic PPA comparison in the same OpenROAD flow; never present it as a foundry-qualified production PDK sign-off.

entries.name: ASAP7 predictive 7nm platform
entries.use_when: Produce a reproducible predictive 7nm PPA study in the same OpenROAD flow; label results as ASAP7 projections, not measured silicon or production-node sign-off.

entries.name: IHP SG13G2 Open PDK
entries.use_when: Target the IHP 130nm open flow and supported MPW/shuttle programs.

entries.name: GlobalFoundries GF180MCU Open PDK
entries.use_when: Target a supported 180nm open-PDK digital/MCU-class design.

entries.name: OpenRAM
entries.use_when: Generate and characterize SRAM macros when the selected PDK and flow are supported.

entries.name: Chipyard and FireSim
entries.use_when: Integrate a RISC-V SoC/accelerator and run cycle-accurate or FPGA-accelerated system simulation.

entries.name: Gemmini
entries.use_when: Reuse or compare against a configurable systolic-array accelerator with DMA, scratchpad, and Chipyard software.

entries.name: NVIDIA Deep Learning Accelerator
entries.use_when: Reuse or compare against an open inference accelerator with convolution, SDP/PDP/CDP blocks, CSB control, memory interfaces, and a published software stack.

entries.name: Apache TVM and VTA
entries.use_when: Use a compiler-integrated FPGA accelerator baseline or generate schedules for custom hardware.

entries.name: CIRCT and firtool
entries.use_when: Lower Chisel/FIRRTL or MLIR hardware dialects to SystemVerilog and run circuit transformations.

entries.name: Chisel
entries.use_when: Develop configurable hardware generators and integrate with Chipyard/Gemmini.

entries.name: Buddy-MLIR
entries.use_when: Compile transformer/LLM workloads through MLIR and target RISC-V or a custom accelerator lowering.

entries.name: IREE
entries.use_when: Build an edge runtime/compiler path or a custom HAL backend for accelerator integration.
